m: हद् cl. 1. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxiii, 8) हदति, ˚ते (pf. जहदे; aor. अहत्त &c. Gr.), to evacuate, discharge excrement, BhP.; Sarasv.; Kathārṇ. : Caus. हादयति Gr.: Desid. जिहत्सते, ib. : Intens. जाहद्यते, जाहत्ति, ib. [cf. Gk. χέζω.]
a: हद् — {c1c} A. (हदते, हन्न) To void excrement, evacuate or discharge feces. --Desid. (जिहत्सते).

m: हद्द m. or हद्दा f. (Arab.) N. of a division of a zodiacal sign (thirty such divisions or degrees are specified; cf. त्रिंशांश), IndSt.; Cat.
